title: Envelope low-pass 2nd order (less lag)
description: 2nd-order 2 Hz low-pass in the causal EMG envelope instead of 4th order (band-pass unchanged), as suggested in Prof. Kearney's mid-project review. The envelope lags about 125 ms instead of 230 ms behind the EMG, with a little more ripple (sample-to-sample jitter about 1.2 % instead of 0.4 % of the level). Everything else as the reference: Active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, per-angle loss scaling, LSTM 8×2 trained with batch 64 (fast protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15, at most 150 epochs), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2, 6 people × 10 seeds. The EMG envelope is causal (forward-only filters: no input uses later EMG, as in a real-time device) and the first and last 1 s of every trial are cut.
